display_long_description:
Stay private and in control of your VR experience with AdGuard VPN. Hide your real IP address, encrypt your traffic, and keep your online activity private while accessing the services and content you need from anywhere. Avoid tracking and ads with DNS-level protection.

FREE VPN WITH REAL PRIVACY
Start using AdGuard VPN for free — no credit card required.
Get essential protection with 3 GB of traffic monthly, or upgrade for unlimited access and optimal performance.

KEEP YOUR ACTIVITY SECURE
Your IP is hidden and traffic is encrypted so websites, apps, and networks can’t see what you do online.
Strict no-logging policy keeps your activity private.

FAST SERVERS IN 80+ LOCATIONS
Connect to stable, high-speed servers worldwide.
Choose from 80+ locations to enjoy smooth VR and everyday use.

FLEXIBLE TRAFFIC CONTROL
Decide what goes through VPN.
Exclude apps or websites, or choose only what should use the VPN while everything else stays outside it.

EASY TO USE
Connect instantly, switch location, or adjust settings across apps and websites.
Change DNS in one step using AdGuard DNS, which helps reduce ads, trackers, and analytics.

MULTI-DEVICE SUPPORT
One account protects up to 10 devices with a paid plan.
Use it on VR, mobile and desktop devices, as well as in browsers.

ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY
TrustTunnel protocol ensures secure, stable connections.
QUIC support improves latency for smoother VR experience.
Post-quantum cryptography adds future-ready protection.
